gap.sketch: Step 2 of 2 of a checked cut of L-meta-2685. Its sibling steps: L-meta-2976. Together they give the parent; the parent's own sketch: No proof is expected here in one piece: propose a cut into smaller statements. Known and checked: moving a wire that already forces the output from an OR gate to the top keeps the function. Repeating it leaves an OR of blocks with no such wire inside. Open: a block that is not a single star (it accepts its pairs only through ANDs of mixed ORs) must cost at least a star cover of the pairs it accepts, even when blocks share gates. No sorry, no new axiom. Own namesp
